title: [CQ-M07v1] Docs: how verified-local is switched on (CONFIGURATION, ARCHITECTURE, CERTIFICATION, architect reference)
definitionOfDone: `git grep -n -e 'unconditionally unavailable' -e 'Nothing here is active yet' -e 'Certification is not activation' -e 'nothing invokes it per candidate yet' -- docs/` prints nothing.

The CONFIGURATION.md executionProfile and checkEnvironments rows match the landed code. Every capability id, evidence id, code, tool and file path they name exists at HEAD; the completion summary lists the greps.
CERTIFICATION.md's activation section gives every operator step with its exact command, and the unsupported list: macOS, gemini/grok, shared mode, and check-architecture without a trusted install.
architect.reference.md states the requiredChecks rule for verified-local plans, and `npm run lint` passes.
The daemon suite passes in a git-archive snapshot with the docs overlaid.
